parse.title: Hoop Cat (Rare Cat)
parse.wikitext:
'''Hoop Cat''' is a [[:Category:Rare Cats|Rare Cat]] that was added in [[Version 3.0 Update|Version 3.0]] and can be unlocked when beating [[Attack on Titanium (Insane)|Attack on Titanium]]. [[True Form]] added in [[Version 8.1 Update|Version 8.1]] greatly increases freeze chance and duration, range, and health. In [[The Battle Cats Unite!]], it can be unlocked when beating [[Gorigori (Cats of the Cosmos)|Gorigori]]. {{Cat Info |ID = 154 |rarity = RR |name1 = Hoop Cat |name2 = Showoff Cat |name3 = Hoopmaster Cat |image1 = 154 1.png |image2 = 154 2.png |image3 = 154 3.png }} ==Evolution== Evolves into '''Showoff Cat''' at level 10. Evolves into '''Hoopmaster Cat''' when obtained from [[Revenge of Titanium (Deadly)|Revenge of Titanium]] (guaranteed to drop) and is level 20 or above. ==Strategy/Usage== This unit can be useful in early game against enemies like [[Metal Hippoe]]. However, exercise caution when using this cat against enemies that come in swarms or have more reach like [[Metal Doge]] or [[Super Metal Hippoe]] respectively. It's generally advised to stack many Hoop Cats, since a large enough stack can render even the most powerful metal enemies useless. Research Cat Combos work well, but may take up needed space, so stacking before a metal boss comes out is encouraged. Meatshielding should suffice in many situations. ==='''True Form'''=== Hoopmaster finally gets more abilities that fix his previous forms' weak points. The increased freeze chance and uptime is very useful when fighting metal enemies and relies on less RNG. However the best point of this unit's true form is the increased range. Hoopmaster can now stay safer from deadly Metal enemies such as [[Super Metal Hippoe]] or [[Sir Metal Seal]].
